explanation: This component is 0 at every D1 and D2 step and fires only at GO when the previous trial was unrewarded, and only late in the episode: it is 0 before about trial 65, around 2-4 at trials 65-75, and reaches 7-10 from trial 80 onward, especially after two or more unrewarded trials in a row. When it fires it is highest for an a1 choice (usually 9-10) and lower for a2 (usually 1-5); after a rewarded trial, or after one unrewarded trial that follows a reward, it is 0-1.
